They truly save lives. The best veterinarians. They treat pets incredibly well, are considerate, and very humane. You can find almost every specialty there, it's open 24/7, and they respond quickly to emergencies. I've been taking my dogs there for years, and we've always received the best care. Highly recommended.

I recently took my husky there for an emergency gastric torsion, and I can't thank the doctors enough for their quick response that saved his life. Dr. Natalia, who rushed him to the hospital, Dr. Carlos, who has been following up with him, but especially Dr. Edgar—that man deserves my utmost respect. He has been Akela's primary veterinarian for several months now, and if it weren't for him, I don't know if my dog ​​would still be here with me. We still have a long road ahead for his recovery, but I have complete faith in the care he receives at this hospital.

Our experience with LOMONT Hospital was deeply distressing. On September 10th, we took our dog Luna, a 5-year-old Shih Tzu, to the clinic because she was lethargic, and we received a diagnosis of enteritis. They told us to buy 10 cans of food and electrolyte solution at the clinic and that she did NOT need to be hospitalized. When she didn't show any improvement, we returned that same day and, after a very quick evaluation, they told us she needed urgent surgery to remove her uterus and ovaries.

We were concerned that, before having a clear understanding of what was happening, they focused on our financial means. We were told that the operation was practically a gamble and that they couldn't guarantee the outcome. We felt that too much emphasis was placed on money at a time when we needed clear medical answers and for Luna's well-being to be prioritized.

The day after the surgery, on September 11th, they informed us that everything had gone well and that she was recovering favorably. However, after signing her discharge papers at 6 p.m., Luna collapsed and was readmitted for observation. An hour later, we were informed that she had passed away due to a blood clot in her brain, but we still have questions about how such a quick conclusion was reached, what tests were performed prior to her surgery, and what happened during the operation.

As a family, we demand clear answers and transparency regarding the medical decisions made. We are seeking to clarify the facts through the appropriate channels.
We are sharing our experience so that other families are aware of how this clinic operates and understand the importance of requesting explanations and demanding clarity when their pets' health is at stake.

Thank you for sharing your feedback. 💙 We understand that the cost of care is a very important factor for every family, and we appreciate you letting us know.

We will take your comment into account as we continue working to create an increasingly clear and personalized experience.
If you have a REAL emergency, don't come; they have no sense of urgency.
Very good service
Excellent service, I am very grateful to the night team, especially Dr. Alexa, who was very professional, understanding, and treated my pet very well.

The service and attention are good, except for the receptionists, who are terrible; and I'm grateful that my dog ​​is now well.

However, for people planning to take their pets there, it's important to keep in mind that THE COSTS ARE HIGH (I spent over $10,000 pesos on tests alone. In addition, my dog ​​was under observation for two days, and the total cost exceeded $20,000 pesos). I'm not mentioning this as a complaint about the veterinary care itself, but because I feel they performed too many tests that, from my point of view, weren't clearly necessary. Furthermore, they didn't give me or share the complete results of these tests, which creates uncertainty and leaves me with many doubts as a customer, perhaps even about potential scams.

I took him in for a dental problem, and although they told me the likely diagnosis from the beginning, they insisted on performing multiple tests "to rule out other pathologies," arguing at the same time that "they didn't know exactly what was wrong with him." In the end, the diagnosis was the same as they had mentioned from the beginning, which I found confusing and made me feel like they ordered unnecessary tests.

Personally, I would only go to this hospital in a true medical emergency. I don't recommend it for routine checkups, as the costs and the number of tests ordered are very high. I suggest getting a second veterinary opinion before spending such large sums of money here.
Excellent service in the evening and the place is in perfect condition. Highly recommended.

Excellent service, all the doctors are very kind, they explain things and accompany you during the diagnosis and the service is very complete, they look for ways to help your furry friend and keep you informed 💖.
High prices but good service
Thank you so much! 💙 …

Our experience at Lomont Patria Veterinary Hospital was excellent. From the moment we arrived, they treated our dog with immense care, patience, and professionalism. All the staff showed incredible compassion; it's clear they truly love animals and understand the concern we feel as members of our family.

They clearly explained everything related to his condition and treatment, answered all our questions, and made us feel calm and supported at all times. Furthermore, the facilities are spotless, very well-equipped, and truly top-notch.

It's rare to find a place that combines expertise, professionalism, first-rate facilities, and, above all, such compassionate care. We left deeply grateful for the attention our dog received. We wholeheartedly recommend them and would trust them again in a heartbeat. Thank you for treating him with such love! 🐶❤️

I arrived urgently to have my dog ​​checked at 8am but they said the doctor was busy and that I should make an appointment starting at 9:40am and I told them that I came to a hospital that is supposed to be 24hrs but they did not want to see us, how inconsistent their attitude.

I know the doctors are good, however, the reception staff needs to be a bit more tactful and understanding.

I called to request a house call and they told me they don't offer that service. I asked if I could come get the doctor to help me carry my dog, and they told me they couldn't leave the premises and that if I wanted, I should FIND ANOTHER PLACE THAT DOES OFFER THAT SERVICE 😡😡😡

My dog ​​swallowed chocolate last night and I had to take him to the emergency vet. I was able to contact the doctors without any problem and they gave me good advice. Once I was there in person, the medical service was excellent; they answered all my questions and were very kind. The fact that they are open 24 hours a day is a huge advantage. I highly recommend them for any medical care or emergency.

(They seem to have fewer staff at night, so there may sometimes be a short wait for phone or in-person appointments depending on availability, but I was seen immediately in person.)
They kept me for 30 minutes and in the end said they couldn't help us, so we didn't have a chance to find out the quality of the services they provide.
Pleasant facilities, dedicated staff, well-scheduled visitor assistance, very clean, very safe medical care, reasonable cost for medical follow-up!
They treated my dog ​​with great care and attention, on time, everything was fine

They make you confirm your appointment. And then they tell you 40 minutes beforehand that they can't see you because they forgot to pass the appointment on to the ophthalmologist. Terrible service, lack of professionalism.
Excellent service and very affectionate with the animals.

Very kind and attentive, they kept me informed at all times during my hospital stay. The ophthalmology department provided a well-explained diagnosis, and Dr. Brenda was very knowledgeable and clear. Definitely 100% recommended.
Everything was great with the service and consultation, the only thing that surprised me was the price of a supplement they recommended, very high for my taste.

The staff is always friendly and attentive to the needs of patients and their families. They are punctual and explain everything in detail. I hope they will consider adding Nephrology to their portfolio of specialties.

They always take excellent care of my dog, closely monitoring her condition. They have very capable doctors like Dr. Natalia, Dr. Luisa Fernanda, and Dr. Eduardo…their entire medical team is highly skilled and accurate in their diagnoses. I am very satisfied with their work and the service they provide. I also want to acknowledge the reception staff for their patience; even with a lot of work, they are always cheerful and helpful. And I congratulate them on the hospital's consistently cleanliness.
They are super nice to pets and aware of the situations
A really great place, especially since they take special care of the cats, keeping them separate from the dogs. It became my favorite place for my 3 cats.
Excellent, warm, and sensitive professional care for the dogs and their families.
They are all very professional and friendly, and they explain everything in detail. I recommend them 100%.
Thank you for sharing your experience with us. 💙 …

Terrible service. They promise many things and good care for your pets, but it's not true; they're only interested in money. They keep ordering tests even though they already know your pet has no chance of survival. They don't give you an accurate diagnosis; they just make assumptions about what's wrong with your dog. They kept her from Sunday to Thursday, and they never gave us the results of the last test they did, nor a medical note. Both times I went to visit her, she had no water, food, or fluids, and according to them, they were giving her intensive care, which isn't true. We took her to another clinic on Thursday afternoon, and the doctor who saw her informed us that in the condition she arrived in, she had little chance of survival. She arrived dehydrated and with a very low temperature; that was the intensive care they gave her. Don't take your pets to that place.

They are very careful and treat your "sick" pets with true patience and affection. They give clear explanations of the illnesses and what is being done to resolve them. We have taken our beloved Roxy there and it has always been satisfactory. Thank you.

Terrible experience. Our dog was hospitalized, and yesterday during our visit we realized she had been given no food or water (I know fasting is sometimes necessary for tests, but IV hydration is essential when fasting). As a result, she suffered severe dehydration and sadly passed away from multiple organ failure. We knew her prognosis was poor due to her initial diagnosis, but they could have given her a more dignified death instead of letting her die like that. If you can avoid this clinic, please do!
The reception staff need to pay more attention to their work, but the facilities are clean, the pets are treated very well, and the veterinarians explain the procedures they will perform very well.
My dog ​​Aria had surgery for a tumor, the follow-up was excellent, the costs weren't outrageous, and you can see the veterinarians' dedication and love for animals ✨️

Everything was great, I really liked it, they were very kind and took excellent care of my dog. There's just one issue: they did an ultrasound and X-rays and told me everything came back clear and that the reception staff would send me the results via WhatsApp. They did, and about three days later I asked if those were all the X-rays (the results). They said they'd made a mistake and sent me the correct ones—they'd sent me the ones from another dog. If I hadn't contacted them, they wouldn't have sent me the correct ones. I wasn't upset, just so they would pay more attention to these details, because I needed to take those results to another oncologist.
Good service, well-equipped, and prices that aren't cheap but I think are reasonable.

Terrible service! I left my dog ​​there for a checkup because she has a heart condition, and they stabilized her. They told me I had to leave her overnight, and the next day I went back early, and they said she was doing very well! Two hours later, they called to say my dog ​​was dying and needed emergency surgery, which they didn't know if she would survive. Even so, they gave me an exorbitant estimate. We took her to another vet who were incredibly kind and compassionate! I should also add that they injured my dog's paw, and now she can't walk.

Excellent care from all the staff, especially Dr. Eduardo and the surgeon, Dr. Alberto. From the first appointment, the diagnosis was very clear, and they only ordered the necessary tests.

My dog ​​needed surgery because she couldn't walk, and she came out great. Her recovery was very quick, and they followed up with her every step of the way. They also treat their patients very well.

THE BEST VETERINARY HOSPITAL IN THE COUNTRY, TRULY! 👏🏼👏🏼👏🏼
The entire team is incredible in every way, but above all, Dr. Eduardo Enrique is the best veterinarian in the country, I can say. He's very professional and very accurate in diagnosing my dog ​​Cornellio's condition. Thanks to him, he's now treating him and managing all his treatments, his ailments are now completely under control. The consultations he provides are top-notch, and I'm truly so grateful to the Doctor and his entire team. I recommend them 100,000%! Seriously, the best in all of Mexico! ✨✨
Excellent service and human touch

Today we went to the hospital for an emergency, and although our diagnosis wasn't good, Dr. Eduardo provided excellent care. He was very empathetic in communicating the diagnosis, and the service was also prompt.

Excellent service from the doctor and the staff. We are grateful to the hospital and its personnel.
Thank you so much! 💙 …
Terrible service. Doctors who are completely unqualified to handle emergencies.

We took our dog Camila for a consultation with Dr. Enrique in the Neurology department. From the very first moment, he was very professional and honest with his diagnosis. He clearly explained our little one's condition and gave us precise recommendations on how to proceed and provide her with the best possible care. He made us feel heard and answered all our questions. If you're looking for veterinarians with true dedication, honesty, and professionalism, this is the right place to take your pet. We highly recommend it!
Excellent service with specialists and 24-hour availability, very accurate diagnoses, and well-trained veterinarians… the hospitalization area is also very comprehensive

I would give it zero stars, but the app won't let me. I took my kitten in for a checkup for periodontal disease. The "doctor," Eduardo, who was also allergic to cats, didn't take a medical history, didn't take her temperature, didn't examine her mouth, barely checked her heart rate (if he even did), pulled out a laptop with images from Google, and tried to convince us that we had to extract ALL of my kitten's teeth. He assumed that "since she's a house cat, she doesn't need them." He also told us that a CT scan was necessary first to determine how many teeth he would extract, and that he would take advantage of the anesthesia. The problem isn't the cost; it's exposing our pet to several stressful procedures and such a traumatic post-surgical period just to line the pockets of a negligent person. If you have the opportunity to take your cats to this place, DON'T TAKE IT. FOR YOUR CATS' SAKE, TAKE THEM TO A SPECIALIZED VETERINARIAN.
Thank you so much! 💙 …

I am so grateful to God for finding this hospital. I feel so at ease taking my pet there! Excellent service, attention, explanations, love, patience, and prices. It's always busy, but you can see that people trust them, and you see the faces of the dogs and cats who leave feeling great, not scared at all. Thank you so much for taking care of my dog! 🙏 Excellent facilities and cleanliness!
Terrible night service. They don't offer emergency care for foreign bodies using endoscopy.
I can only say EXCELLENT SERVICE!! Thank you for the attention to Pimienta, a difficult result but all thanks to Pimienta.
Very good treatment and excellent service 👍 …
Thank you for your rating! 💙 …
Excellent service, well-trained and friendly staff

Words cannot express our gratitude to the entire team at Lomont Veterinary Clinic, especially Dr. Natalia and the cardiology department.

Our dog, Mika, arrived in critical condition, and thanks to their swift intervention, professionalism, and ability to promptly detect a pericardial effusion, she is still with us today. Later, a tumor was confirmed in her heart, devastating news for our family, but we are deeply grateful because, without their immediate attention, Mika likely would not have survived.

In addition to their excellent medical skills, we want to acknowledge the compassionate care they showed Mika and our entire family. During such uncertain and frightening times, they always made us feel supported, informed, and cared for.

Thank you for caring for our little one with such love, dedication, and respect. You gave us something invaluable: more time to share with her and continue creating memories together.

We highly recommend Lomont Veterinary Clinic to anyone seeking excellent medical care for their pets. Eternally grateful.

They treated my dog ​​very well. I went to visit him because he was hospitalized. I took him for a walk and he wanted to go back to the hospital on his own. That means they treated him well because he is very grumpy.

We're sorry your experience wasn't what you expected.
We'll take your feedback into account to continue reviewing and improving our service.

Thank you for your rating! 💙
We appreciate your trust. 🐾 …
Amazing staff and services ✌️

We took our puppy, "Mami," who was very ill, and the veterinarians were with us every step of the way, helping and guiding us to give her a better quality of life.

The facilities and all the staff are incredible; there's nowhere else we'd want to go. We are so grateful for the amazing service they provided.

We highly recommend them! 🐶❤️🙌🏻

Excellent service and attention from the staff. They do everything to ensure your pet's well-being, checking every detail and explaining everything clearly. Highly recommended for routine checkups or emergencies.

Excellent service, Canelo looked fantastic, the facilities were top-notch, we left very happy.

Thank you so much for your hospitality.

The best place for my pet. I took my dog ​​for the first time and the service was exceptional. The medical team is incredibly caring, patient, and very professional. They explain everything in detail and put you at ease. The facilities are spotless and the prices are fair. 100% recommended.
Good service
I appreciate their excellent service, their warmth, and their efficiency in resolving problems. Their professionalism and personalized attention are also greatly appreciated.
Excellent service, the doctors were very friendly, I just wish the waiting time for appointments was shorter
They saved my dog ​​from gastroenteritis
Excellent service, 24 hours.
Dr. Alberto González has always helped us with our dog Janisse. He's an excellent doctor.
Good service, friendly, and they have parking.
Excellent dermatology care! Always grateful for their attention to my pet!
They lack knowledge, it's just an image.

Cleanliness

Thank you for trusting our team 💙🐾 …

When we arrived at Lomont, we knew we'd found superior care!

We have a 15-year-old French Bulldog with chronic health problems due to his advanced age. For many years, we went to a well-known chain of veterinary hospitals to treat his gastritis, and we kept getting the same results: going back and forth for appointments. Since we discovered Lomont, the veterinary staff and Dr. Humberto got to the root causes of his problems, and following the treatment, our dog has made progress we hadn't seen in years and his quality of life has improved dramatically. I can't recommend them enough. A fantastic team.

The best care and team I could find for my dog ​​😊🫶 They are super nice to pets, the service is 10/10, it's very clean, and they are very accurate with illnesses and emergencies. They have EVERYTHING available 24/7. The pharmacy is also very well stocked. …
Thank you for trusting our team 💙🐾 …

I took my dog ​​Po to Lomont Patria Veterinary Hospital and the care was incredible. You can tell they truly care for your pet the way you would.

The vet who saw Po was very attentive, kind, and, above all, very thorough throughout the entire examination. This was our second visit, and once again, we were delighted with the service.

Excellent service, very professional and well-prepared. They performed emergency stomach surgery on my dog ​​and it went perfectly. They also attended to my dog ​​who gave birth and were in contact with me at all times. Everything went very well. I highly recommend them.
I rescued a kitten and all the staff were wonderful to us, they gave me advice and helped me a lot with her 🩷 …
Excellent service
Thank you for your rating! 🐾 …

Excellent service! I brought my rescued dog in, and from day one until today they've been following up with him. Now he's a happy and healthy dog! 🥰 Lomont definitely has the best doctors in Guadalajara! …
Terrible service at reception from two girls who work there; they have zero common sense and basic logic. Very narrow-minded and closed-minded…

They were a huge help with our cat. They welcomed us in the middle of the night and gave us a diagnosis within a few hours. They were always checking in with messages and calls. A few days later, she was back to her old self. Thank you so much! 🩷 …

Overall, the care my pet received was good, nothing extraordinary, except for the unprofessional payment process.
The price is extremely high for a consultation. If you have an emergency, it works, but when it comes to billing, besides the exorbitant prices, it's not enough. They overcharged me for an inpatient service I didn't request. Perhaps it was a mistake, but when it came to the refund, the service was very unprofessional. After telling me they would put it on credit there at the clinic for when I returned—something I didn't ask for and don't even want them to keep my money for when I come back—they couldn't refund my money at that moment, and I had to leave. Later, they told me the money would be back in my account the next day, which didn't happen, and they didn't explain why, only saying, "The relevant department can't issue a refund to your card." They decided to give me the only option via WhatsApp: a cash refund, which took a day and many hours.

So I had to turn around and go all the way back to get my money back.

In any case, the problem wasn't mine. I understand that people make mistakes, and that's okay, but I don't see the reason for the unprofessional handling of the situation, not even an apology, and the failure to address an error that simply wasn't mine.

Thank you.

It's a very clean place, everyone is very friendly, especially with the dogs 🫶🏼
Very professional, highly recommended! 🤗 …
Thank you for trusting our team 💙🐾 …
Excellent place, the facilities are very clean and the service is good; they are very friendly and explain everything in detail.
Thank you so much for your rating! 💙🐾 …

Everyone was very kind, the doctors and staff were excellent.

Amazing place, everyone is friendly and very attentive to pets.
Dr. Edgar took great care of my dog ​​and was very attentive throughout the entire recovery process.
Excellent attention and service
Excellent service from the entire medical team; they have been our regular veterinarian for years and they are the best!

Thank you so much for your trust 💙🐾

It's an excellent place, the staff are very friendly and the doctors are very professional.
Highly recommended, very attentive service and excellent customer service 👍🏼 …

They provided the best care for both me and my dog. The staff was very friendly, answered all my questions, and gave my dog ​​the best treatment.
I would definitely recommend this hospital.

Great experience for my dogs and me.
Excellent staff and reasonable prices. I highly recommend it over other hospitals I've taken my pets to.

Thanks to the Lomont staff!

It was my first time going there. I was looking to get some blood tests done for my dog, and that night the person who answered the phone was very kind and explained everything. But because I saw comments here saying they treated the animals quite roughly, I asked if it was possible for me to be present during the blood draw. The girl who worked the morning shift, Melani, who was quite rude and dismissive, told me no, that wasn't allowed, and that I should look for other options. Literally, instead of offering alternatives, she told me not to come there. I understand perfectly well that they have protocols, but after seeing the reviews about how roughly they treat the animals, I decided to look for another option where they did allow me to be present for the blood draw my dog ​​needed. With that experience, it's clear to me that they definitely treat the animals quite roughly, so be careful when you take them. It's best to look for other alternatives.

Thank you for your rating. 🐾
If you'd like to share more about your experience, we'd be happy to hear from you and follow up. …
Dr. Andrea is the best, incredible service and humanity.
Change that terrible customer service to provide references
We received excellent service, the staff was very friendly, the clinic was very clean, and the doctors were very attentive to the dogs.

Warm greetings
Lomont Patria Veterinary Hospital

Excellent hospital, everyone is very professional and the doctors are very kind, they explain their findings in detail and are concerned with providing the best solution.
Excellent service, everyone was very friendly and the place was very nice and clean.

I forgot to leave my review.
Ever since I took my approximately 8-month-old puppy there, he's been terrified of veterinarians. They left him with a very bad neck injury, which didn't resolve for many months, all thanks to the extreme restraint they used on him, because obviously they don't let you bring your pet in.
I absolutely do not recommend this place. I hope they improve their treatment of pets and even their customers. They didn't resolve his skin problem; on the contrary, I had to treat him for yet another condition, thanks to this hospital.
The doctors are truly excellent! They have everything necessary to ensure your pet will recover fully from their illness.

Good afternoon. I wanted to share that my pets and I have always received excellent treatment from the medical and reception staff. They are very professional in their approach to pets and provide prompt service.
They have highly trained personnel and state-of-the-art equipment, which allows for quick and accurate diagnoses. Treatment follow-up is personalized, with highly professional doctors available 24/7. I am very happy with the care provided. Thank you.
We had an excellent experience, Alberto is an extraordinary doctor, my daughter is perfect
Excellent veterinary hospital. We have a silky terrier who required knee surgery on the cruciate and lateral ligaments, and they did an excellent job and were very attentive to our pet's needs.

Horrible experience!! I took my dog ​​to the vet alone, and the doctor was incredibly rude and awful!! They said they were only going to do an ultrasound on my pet, and in the end, they gave me a quote of almost 30,000 pesos and told me I had to leave him because it was necessary and, according to them, the only good option. I couldn't leave him because I really wanted a second opinion since the price they quoted seemed very high. They made me sign some documents to release them from liability because I was going to take him (since I wasn't from Guadalajara). Why sign papers if he was supposedly only going to have an ultrasound? Oh, and it turns out they gave him such a botched injection, which I obviously never authorized, nor did they tell me they were going to do that, and they punctured a sac he had, causing sepsis!! My dog ​​died the next day!!! A terrible experience… BE VERY CAREFUL

It's an excellent place! Everyone is so kind and treats the dogs incredibly well; you can see their love and dedication, along with their great skill and knowledge in their field. Dr. Miriam, Dr. Alejandra, and Dr. Natalia are angels. I'm so grateful because they saved my dog ​​not once, but twice when I thought she wasn't going to make it. They always kept me well-informed about my girl's condition and go out of their way to make sure the animals are okay. I highly recommend them!
Excellent service! I've visited this place several times and we're always happy with the service!
Excellent service from the staff, they are all very friendly
There's a lot of room for improvement with the reception team; they need to improve their customer service and communication skills.

Wonderful doctors, but terrible receptionists. They give incomplete information and always seem to be in a bad mood. They've made me jump through hoops for the most basic test in the world because every time I come, they add another detail to the instructions.

Excellent care! The veterinarian who treated my cat was incredibly careful, professional, and very clear in explaining my cat's condition. The clinic was also spotless, and the staff were very respectful and friendly. I highly recommend them.
Excellent veterinary medical care service, they saved my big-headed dog's life after he was hit by a car.

DON'T TAKE CATS...it turns out that after a terrible experience with a clinic I trusted, where the owner herself recommended a "specialist" for one of my kittens with a complicated case, it turned out she didn't have a professional license...I decided to look around...Lomont is close to me...and no...my daughter took one of my kittens there...who hurt his paw...and it turns out that the "orthopedic" doctor told her, "I DON'T LIKE CATS." What's more, he didn't even want to touch him...when taking his temperature rectally, my daughter had to hold him because he almost fell off the table because the young man didn't want to touch him...ALSO, THIS IS THE SECOND TIME THEY'VE TOLD ME they can't handle some cases and that I should go to Mexico City...both times I've gone, they send me there if it "doesn't work well here," and it's always expensive Extremely high prices... A truly terrible experience... Oh, and a recommended kitten they wanted to keep for several more days, and a day later they still didn't have a diagnosis... IF YOU DON'T WANT CATS... PUT UP A SIGN... BAD... THEY DON'T KNOW... YES... CLEAN... YES... LOTS OF PEOPLE... but they take a long time to respond via WhatsApp... and expensive for what they do... it seems they only want to give fatalistic diagnoses to make money... and very importantly... the medical director saw me and gave me a diagnosis... and I told him, "I'd like to get another opinion"... at that moment he got angry... called and said he was going to come get my cat... (This, of course, after hearing his fatalistic diagnosis and his recommendation to go to Mexico City to get my cat a new hip for a fractured femoral head... BAD... BAD. Maybe they know about dogs... with cats... they're lost... bad, bad... for an emergency... and if you get the one who studied He's a veterinarian and he doesn't like cats... HE SHOULD CHANGE PROFESSIONS....
Thank you for your rating! 🐾 …
Thank you for your rating! 🐾 …
Thank you for your trust! We're glad to hear your experience was positive 🐾 …

I began to doubt the ethics of this place when my dog ​​stayed for X-rays and they contacted us offering to keep her under observation overnight. I refused because she wasn't seriously ill enough to require monitoring or medication. We went to pick her up a few minutes later and they told us our dog was doing very well and that we only needed to monitor her appetite at home—nothing serious enough to warrant an overnight stay at the hospital. That's when I realized the stay wasn't necessary.

I told them that my dog ​​has a diagnosis of allergies from her dermatologist so they would have context about her condition, and they tried to use that to discredit me and push me to use the clinic's dermatology services. Other clinics order one test at a time, but here they try to push every possible test on you. That's why I reiterate that there is no professional ethics, or if they have them, they are very limited.

The strategy is to instill fear by exploiting the vulnerability and ignorance of owners to get them to sign up for tests or stays. I took my dog ​​there a few days later for an emergency after a dog attack. They treated her there, but she was still feeling unwell. When I went back for a follow-up appointment, two doctors at that clinic told me she needed surgery because the wound was infected. They quoted me for a culture, surgery, and everything else… I told them no and that I would get a second opinion… and that's when the veterinarian said, “If it were my dog, I'd already be operating on her.” That's when I realized the attempt to manipulate me into agreeing.

At the second consultation, without giving them this context, they told me that the fluids were normal and that the wound looked well cared for (it's the second dog attack I've treated for her). They said the reason for the panting was nausea/pain and prescribed treatment for that. When I told them about the initial diagnosis, they said they didn't share the same opinion about surgery and that it wasn't necessary. They even checked her lab results during the same appointment to see if she needed antibiotics, and the sample came back clear. My dog ​​is currently much better and didn't need surgery.

I've attached a picture of the supposed infected bite.
They were super friendly, they took good care of my dog ​​in an emergency.

A world-class veterinary clinic, very clean, and they respect your appointment.
